chapters.title: The Name Machine
chapters.completeText: Every animal in the yard wears a name now. Tomorrow the machine moves to the kitchen.

tasks.prompt: The tag machine wakes up. Its first customer purrs and waits.
tasks.success: CAT. The tag clips on and the purring gets louder.

tasks.prompt: Someone barks at the machine and wags a tail.
tasks.success: DOG. The tail wags even faster.

tasks.prompt: A pink customer rolls in straight from the mud.
tasks.success: PIG. The tag stays clean, the customer does not.

tasks.prompt: A feathered neighbor steps up and clucks twice.
tasks.success: HEN. She struts off to show the tag to the eggs.

tasks.prompt: A big slow customer moos at the little machine.
tasks.success: COW. The bell and the tag ring together.

tasks.prompt: A small grey shape sneaks out from behind the machine.
tasks.success: RAT. The tag is bigger than the customer.

tasks.prompt: Something yellow buzzes around the pile of tags.
tasks.success: BEE. The tag flies away with her.

tasks.prompt: The tiniest customer of the day climbs up the machine.
tasks.success: ANT. Six legs carry the tag home.

tasks.prompt: A red tail slips out of the bushes.
tasks.success: FOX. The tag disappears into the bushes too.

tasks.prompt: The last customer hangs from the machine upside down.
tasks.success: BAT. The tag hangs upside down as well.

chapters.title: The Kitchen Labels
chapters.completeText: Every pot and jar has its label back. Now the family can pack for the trip.

tasks.prompt: All the labels fell off the shelf. The first thing is still warm from the fire.
tasks.success: PAN. The eggs can start cooking.

tasks.prompt: Something round is bubbling on the stove.
tasks.success: POT. The soup gets its label back.

tasks.prompt: A cold drink with a straw waits on the table.
tasks.success: CUP. The straw squeaks a thank you.

tasks.prompt: Steam rises from something with a handle.
tasks.success: MUG. The cocoa is still hot.

tasks.prompt: Two small brown shells roll across the counter.
tasks.success: NUT. The shells crack open.

tasks.prompt: The dog has been staring at the top shelf all morning.
tasks.success: HAM. The dog is still staring.

tasks.prompt: Something round and baked comes out of the oven.
tasks.success: BUN. It is far too hot to hold.

tasks.prompt: An empty glass thing with a lid stands by the window.
tasks.success: JAR. It is ready for the berries.

tasks.prompt: A metal tin rolls out of the cupboard.
tasks.success: CAN. The label sticks on the first try.

tasks.prompt: The last thing on the shelf whistles when it is ready.
tasks.success: TEA. The whole kitchen smells of mint.

chapters.title: Packing for the Trip
chapters.completeText: The bags are packed and the road is open. The first stop is a camp in the woods.

tasks.prompt: Packing starts with something to put everything else in.
tasks.success: BAG. It opens wide and waits.

tasks.prompt: A big folded paper shows the roads and the rivers.
tasks.success: MAP. The way to the sea is marked in red.

tasks.prompt: The sun is strong, so this one goes on the head.
tasks.success: HAT. The shade comes along for free.

tasks.prompt: A smaller one with a stiff front goes into the bag too.
tasks.success: CAP. The visor keeps the sun out of the eyes.

tasks.prompt: Nobody in this family travels without a soft friend.
tasks.success: TOY. The friend gets the best seat.

tasks.prompt: Everyone is ready. Something waits by the gate with open doors.
tasks.success: CAR. The doors click shut and the trip begins.

tasks.prompt: A long yellow one stops at the corner.
tasks.success: BUS. It is full of people and bags.

tasks.prompt: A taller one carries the big boxes.
tasks.success: VAN. Everything fits inside.

tasks.prompt: Something is roaring high above the road.
tasks.success: JET. It leaves a white line across the sky.

tasks.prompt: A yellow one with a lamp on the roof waits for a wave.
tasks.success: CAB. The driver waves back.

chapters.title: The Camp in the Woods
chapters.completeText: The camp is packed away. The road leads on to the town fair.

tasks.prompt: A piece of a tree lies by the fire pit.
tasks.success: LOG. It makes a very good seat.

tasks.prompt: Something sharp leans against the wood pile.
tasks.success: AXE. The wood splits with a crack.

tasks.prompt: Another tool has small teeth along one side.
tasks.success: SAW. The teeth sing through the branch.

tasks.prompt: A little round house with a straw roof stands by the path.
tasks.success: HUT. The door is already open.

tasks.prompt: Silver threads shine between two branches.
tasks.success: WEB. The spider is still working on it.

tasks.prompt: Something full of holes waits by the water.
tasks.success: NET. Not one fish today.

tasks.prompt: A small green thing crawls along a leaf.
tasks.success: BUG. The leaf gets a little shorter.

tasks.prompt: Inside the hut there is a soft place for the night.
tasks.success: BED. The pillow is cool on both sides.

tasks.prompt: In the morning something climbs up over the trees.
tasks.success: SUN. The camp warms up fast.

tasks.prompt: Turn this one and cold water comes out.
tasks.success: TAP. All the bottles are full again.

chapters.title: The Big Fair
chapters.completeText: The fair is over and every word on the way was read. Words that look almost the same cannot fool you now.

tasks.prompt: Someone runs ahead to the ticket booth.
tasks.success: BOY. He is first in the line.

tasks.prompt: A tall grown-up pays for the tickets.
tasks.success: MAN. He keeps them all in one pocket.

tasks.prompt: The ring toss shows a number after every hit.
tasks.success: TEN. The best score of the day.

tasks.prompt: The first funny mirror makes one thing huge.
tasks.success: EYE. It blinks back, twice as big.

tasks.prompt: The next mirror stretches something strong.
tasks.success: ARM. It looks ready to lift the whole tent.

tasks.prompt: The last mirror makes walking very funny.
tasks.success: LEG. Two long steps cross the whole room.

tasks.prompt: On the prize shelf something sparkles.
tasks.success: GEM. It throws little lights on the wall.

tasks.prompt: The prize is wrapped and something soft sits on top.
tasks.success: BOW. The ribbon is bright red.

tasks.prompt: The clown wears something long around his neck.
tasks.success: TIE. He spins it like a propeller.

tasks.prompt: The last stall smells of apples and warm crust.
tasks.success: PIE. Everyone at the fair gets a slice.
